### A Struggling Saint
Author: Neil T. Anderson
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/dailyinchrist/daily-in-christ-2-or-17-544368.html
Passage: Romans 7:15
Points:
- Believers genuinely desire to obey God, yet frequently struggle with doing what they hate.
- Paul identifies the source of this internal conflict as indwelling sin rather than the Christian's core identity.
- A believer is not fundamentally evil, but a saint wrestling with lingering sin.
- Christians must actively refuse to let sin rule and instead offer their bodies to God for righteousness.

### Evil Lurking Close at Hand
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/evil-lurking-close-hand
Passage: Romans 7:21
Points:
- Sin remains an active adversary that continually seeks to regain dominance over the believer.
- Paul's words do not excuse personal sin, but clarify who believers truly are in Christ.
- The old Adamic habits may feel familiar, but they no longer fit someone clothed in Jesus.
- Standing firm in our redeemed identity empowers us to resist temptation and advance in sanctification.
